distribution.note: Vend-R-created vocabulary may be distributed independently. Cross-pack brand-affinity references are identifiers only and should degrade gracefully when the CircleofNoms pack is absent.

policy: These concepts fill mundane-commerce gaps for generation. They are not claims that named products canonically exist in Cyberpunk RED. Brand affinities are conservative merchandising inferences and default to avoid when unlisted.
